Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: In the second step (the first Planner update after the initial WebSurfer search), the Planner incorrectly concluded that "Norris Bradbury" directed the project. The Planner stated: "Likely answer: Norris Bradbury, who directed Los Alamos (Project Y) and oversaw the assembly of the first atomic device (Trinity) at the same site where Feynman worked on the Water Boiler." This is a factual error. While Norris Bradbury did later become the director of Los Alamos, J. Robert Oppenheimer was the director of the Manhattan Project at Los Alamos (Project Y) during the development of the first atomic bomb (Trinity test in 1945). The correct answer is Robert Oppenheimer. The Planner's premature and incorrect shift to Bradbury as the primary answer caused the subsequent search strategy to focus on Bradbury, leading to a wrong solution path until later corrections were made.
